xinjianxue-skill-classmate-qa-global v1.0.1

- Updated SKILL.md documentation; no logic or endpoint changes.
- Removed redundant file: skill-card.md.

- Initial release of the XinJianXue "Classmate Relations Advisor" skill package for global use.
- Provides personality and relationship analysis, behavior reading, and emotional guidance focused on classmate relations.
- Strict activation criteria: analysis only triggered when explicitly requested and subject is confirmed.
- Implements a one-time onboarding and binding process, requiring an AI business license and user-provided authorization code.
- Supports secure, authenticated API calls to www.xinjianxue.com for all service operations, with explicit confirmation required before sharing personal information.
